newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks close sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks close sharply lower.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks were rocked by heavy profit-taking Monday, which threw the Dow Jones industrial average for a huge loss of more than 190 points.
Wall Street was also rattled by a comment from Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto that stable exchange rates are critical to Japan maintaining its holdings of U.S. government securities.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended 192.25 points lower, or off 2.47 percent, at 7,604.26, in a sharp retreat after Friday's record close of 7,796.51.
In the broader market, declining issues swamped advances 2-1 on active volume of 497 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
